lines: Stop! Don't move! ...Okay, you can move. I was checking for wobbles.
I'm Leo. Did you hear about the giggly thing that got out of the Haunted House? What if it comes back? What if it brings friends?
What if there's a flood? Or a snowstorm? Or a really big wind that blows all the clouds away?
Nobody else ever gets ready for anything. So I have to get ready for EVERYTHING.
I need an emergency kit for my bunker. Will you help? Please? Just in case?
Really? Okay! Okay okay okay. I made a list. Four things.
A water jug, by the Market fountain. A torch, on the Library steps. A cozy blanket, in the Cozy Cave. And a snack box, on the dock.
Then we take them to my bunker. In the meadow, south of the lake. It has a door. A strong one.
That's okay. I'll just... stand here and keep an eye on the sky.
Water jug by the fountain. Torch on the Library steps. Blanket in the Cozy Cave. Snacks on the dock.
I've checked the list eleven times. Twelve, now.
You got EVERYTHING? Bring it in! Put it on the shelves, by the round hatch.
Snacks on the top shelf. In case of floods. Snacks hate floods.
(Leo's standing very still. His ears are straight up and his paws are shaking.)
D-did you hear that? That WAIL? It's an emergency. It's THE emergency. I knew it. I KNEW it.
{player}: Leo, it's okay. Let's work it out together.

choice.text: Breathe with me. In for four, out for four.
lines: In... two... three... four. Out... two... three... four.
(You do it together three times. Leo's ears come down a little.)

choice.text: Let's look around. Is anything actually wrong?
lines: (You look together. The lake's calm. The Market's busy. Someone's buying a snack.)
Nothing's on fire. Nothing's flooding. The clouds are all still there.

choice.text: Think of your happy place. What's it like?
lines: My happy place... it's the Cloud Nest. Quiet side. Soft, and warm, and you can see everything coming.
(Leo closes his eyes. His paws stop shaking.)
AWOOOOOOO!
(Over the lake, on top of the Skate Park ramp, Rook is howling at the mothership as it floats past.)
...It's Rook. It's just Rook. Howling at the mothership.
My brain shouted EMERGENCY, and it wasn't one. It was a dog. Saying hello to a spaceship.
My dad says my brain has a smoke alarm in it, and mine's a bit TOO good at its job. It goes off for toast.
Being ready is good. My kit's really good! But being so ready that I never do anything fun... that's not good either.
Will you come up the zipline with me some time? Not today. But some time. I'll pack a snack.

rotate: Ready Leo, reporting! The bunker's stocked. Now I don't have to think about it all the time, because it's done.
I went on the zipline! Halfway. Then I came back. Next time, all the way.
If my brain's alarm goes off now, I ask: is it an emergency, or is it Rook?

lines: Is that cloud moving? It's moving. Oh, they all move. Never mind.
